feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. Evidence: in iteration 1, the ±0.03 m span raised s-bend finishes from 5/20 to 16/20, but the slalom stayed at 0/20 with 1.05 line-loss events and max_error 0.064. In iteration 2, the 16 mm footprint did not fix the slalom (0/20, 1.0 line-loss events, max_error 0.0646), and s-bend finishes fell to 15/20. Footprint is therefore not the limit. Slalom steering_oscillation stayed near 0.20 in both runs, so lag is suspected but not proven. The 0.04 m lead is the next variable. Next-race rules: if the slalom still shows line loss before exit (line_loss_events near 1 or more, max_error near 0.06) with lead 0.04 m, lead is not the main limit, so change wheel_track as below. If s-bend steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35 while finishes do not improve, narrow the span rather than adding more lead reduction. If the slalom shows no line loss and still does not finish, check turn authority.
requested_changes: If the slalom still exits with line loss before the exit at lead 0.04 m, keep the 12 mm footprint and try lead y = 0.02 m across all seven sensors, provided s-bend steering_oscillation stays at or below 0.35 (iteration 1 measured 0.34 and iteration 2 measured 0.33).

If s-bend steering_oscillation rises above 0.35 with no gain in finishes, narrow the span to x = ±0.025 m with 0.0083 m pitch and keep 12 mm footprints (iteration 1 showed the ±0.03 m span is what raised s-bend jitter from 0.25 to 0.34).

If line-loss events on the slalom fall but no trial finishes, reduce wheel_track from 0.12 to 0.10 m for more turn authority at the slalom's direction changes; the oval finishes at 1.84 s, so there is time margin for this.
